Experience: 2 years
Job Description: Software Tester – Manual Testing
 Experience Required: 2 Years – 5 Years
 Job Overview 
 Join Cyber Infrastructure (CIS), a CMMI Level 5 company, as a Senior Software Tester. You'll play a crucial role in ensuring the quality of world-class software for our global clients, primarily in the US and EMEA. In our AI-augmented delivery environment, you will apply your meticulous testing skills to complex web applications, collaborate with a dynamic team, and contribute directly to client success. We offer a stable career with clear pathways for growth and opportunities to mentor junior team members.
 Educational Qualifications
 BE/ME/B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/MCM/BCA/MSc, PGDCA, or equivalent degree in a related field.
 Roles and Responsibilities 

• Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.

• Perform various types of manual testing, including functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing.

• Thoroughly test web applications to ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsive design.

• Identify, document, and track defects with precision using tools like JIRA, ensuring clear communication with the development team.

• Analyze business requirements to identify gaps, ambiguities, and potential issues before development begins.

• Prepare and maintain key QA documentation, including test plans, defect reports, and status reports.

• Collaborate closely with developers, project managers, and client stakeholders to ensure quality standards are met throughout the STLC.

• Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to debug issues and ensure a high-quality end product.

 Minimum Required Skills 

• Proven hands-on experience in Manual Software Testing for web applications.

• Strong knowledge of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

• Expertise in creating detailed test cases, test scenarios, and managing test data.

• Proficiency in defect management and reporting using tools like JIRA.

• Experience in functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing methodologies.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills with a detail-oriented approach.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills for effective team collaboration.

 Preferred Skills

• Basic knowledge of databases/SQL for backend data validation.

• Familiarity with API testing tools like Postman or Swagger.

• Exposure to performance and security testing concepts.

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail or QTest.

• Basic understanding of automated testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium) and scripting languages (e.g., Java, Python).
